rdfs:label: EmailMessage
rdfs:comment: An email message — represents a single sent or received email as RDF.
notes: Subclass of `schema:Message` (`urn:solid:ChatMessage`) and `urn:solid:CreativeWork`. Not an email address — for addresses use `urn:solid:hasEmail` / `urn:solid:mbox` / `urn:solid:email`. Pair with `schema:sender`, `schema:recipient`, `schema:about`, `schema:dateSent`, `schema:dateReceived`. Useful for archival/threading systems that index email as RDF rather than treating each message as opaque text.

history.note: seeAlso uses urn:solid:ChatMessage for schema:Message; notes clarify this is not an email address.
